ko.title: 이틀간 거의 800대의 드론: 새로운 평화 추진과 맞물린 우크라이나의 역대 최대 모스크바 공습

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## 장거리 공습의 급격한 고조

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: 우크라이나는 이번 주 모스크바 지역을 상대로 전쟁 발발 이후 최대 규모의 드론 작전 중 하나라고 관계자들이 묘사하는 공습을 감행했으며, 이와 유사한 대규모 포격이 있은 지 불과 이틀 만에 러시아 수도를 향해 무인 항공기 파도를 보냈습니다.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: 두 차례의 포격을 합치면 약 800대에 가까운 드론이 동원된 것으로 보도되었으며, 이는 최근 분쟁의 양상을 점점 더 규정해 온 장거리 공습의 상당한 격화를 나타냅니다.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: 러시아 방공 당국은 인구 밀집 지역에 도달하기 전에 대부분의 드론이 요격되거나 전파 방해를 받았다고 밝혔으나, 모스크바 일부 공항에서는 차질이 보고되었으며 임시 운항 제한으로 인해 도착과 출발에 영향이 있었습니다.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: 해당 지역의 현지 당국은 여러 구역에서 파편이 떨어졌다고 보고했으며, 이에 따라 잠시 대피와 조사가 이루어졌으나 피해의 전체적인 규모는 독립적으로 확인되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 키이우는 러시아 영토 깊숙한 곳을 겨냥한 장거리 작전에 대한 일반적인 관례에 따라 이번 특정 공습에 대해 공식적으로 책임을 인정하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: 우크라이나 관계자들은 이전에 이러한 공습이 러시아의 전쟁 노력을 지원하는 군산복합 시설, 연료 저장고, 군수 물류 허브를 목표로 한다고 밝힌 바 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## 하르키우 지역을 향한 치명적인 미사일 공습

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: 드론 공습이 고조된 것과 같은 주에 러시아의 미사일 공습이 우크라이나 하르키우 지역의 한 마을을 타격하여 지역 당국에 따르면 최소 10명이 사망했습니다.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: 우크라이나 당국은 이번 공습이 주거 지역을 타격했다고 밝혔으며, 그 후 몇 시간 동안 수색 및 구조 작업이 계속되었습니다.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: 이번 공격은 우크라이나 관계자들의 규탄을 받았으며, 이들은 이를 최전선 근처의 민간인 지역에 영향을 미치는 광범위한 공습 패턴의 일부로 묘사했습니다.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: 러시아 관계자들은 이번 특정 공습에 대해 상세한 논평을 내놓지 않았으며, 양측이 각기 다른 성격으로 규정하는 목표물을 향해 감행한 장거리 공격의 광범위하고 엇갈린 기록의 일부로 상황이 남아 있습니다. 키이우는 대개 군사 및 인프라 목표물을 언급하고, 모스크바는 종종 자국의 군사 및 에너지 자산을 겨냥한 캠페인이라고 묘사합니다.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## 평행하는 외교적 트랙

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: 공습이 격화되는 와중에도 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 대통령은 우크라이나가 전쟁 종식을 목표로 하는 새로운 제안 세트를 워싱턴에 전달했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: 젤렌스키 정부는 이 제안들을 지속적인 군사적 압박과 함께 외교적 동력을 유지하기 위한 노력으로 포장했으며, 이는 우크라이나가 분쟁 기간 동안 여러 시점에서 추구해 온 투트랙 접근 방식입니다.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: 논의에 정통한 관계자들에 따르면, 미국 협상가들은 양측 입장 간의 격차를 좁히기 위한 새로운 추진의 일환으로 며칠 내에 키이우와 모스크바를 모두 방문할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: 우크라이나의 최신 제안 세부 사항은 공개되지 않았으며, 영토선, 안보 보장, 휴전 시기 등의 문제에 대해 워싱턴이나 모스크바가 이전에 제기했던 입장들과 얼마나 긴밀하게 일치하는지는 여전히 불분명합니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 다가올 일

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이번 전쟁에서 격화된 공습과 적극적인 협상이 상호 배타적이지 않다고 지적합니다. 양측은 외교 채널이 열려 있는 동안에도 거듭 전장의 우위를 모색해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: 미국 협상가들이 두 수도 사이를 오갈 것으로 보도된 다가오는 며칠은 현재의 협상 라운드가 진정한 돌파구를 의미하는지 아니면 빠른 해결을 거부해 온 분쟁 속의 또 다른 막간인지를 더 명확한 신호로 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: 당분간 전선 양측의 주민들은 키이우, 모스크바, 워싱턴의 관계자들이 협상 테이블에서 다음 단계를 저울질하는 동안에도 고조되는 장거리 캠페인의 직접적인 결과에 계속 직면하고 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article reflects publicly reported statements from Ukrainian and Russian officials as of this week; details of ongoing military operations and diplomatic talks may evolve rapidly.*
segments.tr: *이 기사는 이번 주 기준 우크라이나 및 러시아 당국의 공개적으로 보도된 성명을 반영하며, 진행 중인 군사 작전 및 외교 회담의 세부 사항은 빠르게 바뀔 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 两天内近 800 架无人机：乌克兰对莫斯科发起迄今最大规模袭击，恰逢新一轮和平斡旋

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## 远程袭击骤然升级

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: 乌克兰本周发起了官员们所称的开战以来对莫斯科地区最大规模的无人机行动之一，就在仅两天前发动了一次同样大规模的密集轰炸之后，再次向俄罗斯首都派遣了一波又波的无人机。

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: 据报道，这两次齐射总共涉及近 800 架无人机，标志着日益定义该冲突近期阶段的远程交火迎来了重大升级。

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯防空官员表示，大部分无人机在到达人口稠密地区之前就被拦截或干扰，不过莫斯科的一些机场收到了干扰报告，临时航班限制影响了起降。

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: 该地区的当地交通部门报告称多个地区有坠落的残骸，引发了短暂的疏散和检查，不过总体破坏程度尚未得到独立证实。

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 按照其对俄罗斯领土深处远程行动的一贯做法，基辅方面尚未正式对这些具体袭击宣布负责。

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: 乌克兰官员此前曾表示，此类袭击旨在打击支持俄罗斯战争努力的军工基础设施、燃料库和物流枢纽。

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## 哈尔科夫地区遭遇致命导弹袭击

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: 据当地官员称，无人机袭击升级的同一周，俄罗斯导弹袭击了乌克兰哈尔科夫地区的一个村庄，造成至少 10 人死亡。

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: 乌克兰当局表示，袭击击中了居民区，搜救行动在随后的几个小时内继续进行。

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: 这次袭击招致了乌克兰官员的谴责，他们将其描述为影响前线附近平民区域的更广泛袭击模式的一部分。

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯官员尚未对这次具体袭击发表详细评论，而事件的具体情况仍然属于双方对不同定性目标实施的更广泛、有争议的远程袭击记录的一部分——基辅通常引用军事和基础设施目标，莫斯科往往将其自身的行动定性为针对乌克兰的军事和能源资产。

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## 平行的外交轨道

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: 尽管袭击有所加剧，总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，乌克兰已向华盛顿提交了一份旨在结束战争的新建议。

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: 泽连斯基政府将这些建议定性为在保持持续军事施压的同时保持外交势头的努力，这是基辅在整个冲突期间的不同时期所采取的双轨策略。

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: 据熟悉讨论情况的官员透露，作为缩小双方立场差距的新努力的一部分，预计美国谈判代表将在未来几天前往基辅和莫斯科。

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: 乌克兰最新建议的细节尚未公开，目前尚不清楚它们在领土界线、安全保障和任何停火时间表等问题上与华盛顿或莫斯科此前提出的立场契合程度如何。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的走向

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，在这场战争中，加剧的袭击和积极的谈判并不相互排斥；即便外交渠道依然畅通，双方也一再寻求战场上的筹码。

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: 接下来的几天——据报道美国谈判代表将在两个首都之间穿梭——可能会提供一个更清晰的信号，即当前这一轮谈判是代表着真正的突破契机，还是这场难以快速解决的冲突中的又一个插曲。

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: 目前，即使基辅、莫斯科和华盛顿的官员正在评估谈判桌上的下一步行动，前线两侧的居民仍继续面临着不断升级的远程行动所带来的直接后果。

segments.src: *This article reflects publicly reported statements from Ukrainian and Russian officials as of this week; details of ongoing military operations and diplomatic talks may evolve rapidly.*
segments.tr: *本文反映了截至本周乌克兰和俄罗斯官员公开报道的声明；正在进行的军事行动和外交谈判的细节可能会迅速演变。*

hi.title: दो दिनों में लगभग 800 ड्रोन: नए शांति प्रयास के साथ मेल खाते हैं मास्को पर यूक्रेन के सबसे बड़े हमले

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## लंबी दूरी के हमलों में तेज वृद्धि

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: यूक्रेन ने इस हफ्ते मास्को क्षेत्र के खिलाफ युद्ध के सबसे बड़े ड्रोन अभियानों में से एक को अंजाम दिया है, जिसे अधिकारियों ने बताया है, जिसमें रूसी राजधानी की ओर मानवरहित विमानों की लहरें भेजी गईं, जो कि इसी तरह की भारी बैराज के ठीक दो दिन बाद थीं।

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: संयुक्त रूप से, दोनों हमलों में लगभग 800 ड्रोन शामिल होने की सूचना है, जो लंबी दूरी के आदान-प्रदान में एक महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि को चिह्नित करता है जिसने हाल ही में संघर्ष के चरण को तेजी से परिभाषित किया है।

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: रूसी वायु रक्षा अधिकारियों ने कहा कि आबादी वाले क्षेत्रों तक पहुंचने से पहले अधिकांश ड्रोन को रोक दिया गया था या जाम कर दिया गया था, हालांकि मास्को के कुछ हवाई अड्डों पर व्यवधान की सूचना मिली थी, जिसमें आगमन और प्रस्थान को प्रभावित करने वाले अस्थायी उड़ान प्रतिबंध शामिल थे।

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: क्षेत्र के स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने कई जिलों में मलबे के गिरने की सूचना दी, जिससे संक्षिप्त निकासी और निरीक्षण हुए, हालांकि नुकसान के कुल पैमाने को स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: कीव ने रूसी क्षेत्र के भीतर गहरी लंबी दूरी के अभियानों के संबंध में अपनी सामान्य प्रथा के अनुरूप, विशिष्ट हमलों के लिए आधिकारिक तौर पर जिम्मेदारी का दावा नहीं किया है।

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: यूक्रेनी अधिकारियों ने पहले कहा है कि ऐसे हमले सैन्य-औद्योगिक बुनियादी ढांचे, ईंधन डिपो और रसद केंद्रों को लक्षित करते हैं जो रूस के युद्ध प्रयास का समर्थन करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## खार्किव क्षेत्र पर घातक मिसाइल हमला

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: ड्रोन में वृद्धि उसी सप्ताह आई जब एक रूसी मिसाइल हमले ने यूक्रेन के खार्किव क्षेत्र के एक गांव को मारा, जिसमें क्षेत्रीय अधिकारियों के अनुसार कम से कम दस लोग मारे गए।

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: यूक्रेनी अधिकारियों ने कहा कि हमले ने एक आवासीय क्षेत्र को मारा, और खोज और बचाव अभियान बाद के घंटों में जारी रहे।

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: इस हमले ने यूक्रेनी अधिकारियों की निंदा की, जिन्होंने इसे सामने की रेखा के पास नागरिक क्षेत्रों को प्रभावित करने वाले हमलों के व्यापक पैटर्न के हिस्से के रूप में वर्णित किया।

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: रूसी अधिकारियों ने विशिष्ट हमले पर विस्तृत टिप्पणी जारी नहीं की है, और परिस्थितियां लंबी दूरी के हमलों के व्यापक, विवादित रिकॉर्ड का हिस्सा बनी हुई हैं जिन्हें दोनों पक्षों ने उन लक्ष्यों के खिलाफ बाहर किया है जिन्हें वे अलग तरह से चित्रित करते हैं - कीव आम तौर पर सैन्य और बुनियादी ढांचे के उद्देश्यों का हवाला देता है, मास्को अक्सर अपने स्वयं के अभियान को यूक्रेनी सैन्य और ऊर्जा संपत्तियों को लक्षित करने के रूप में वर्णित करता है।

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## एक समानांतर कूटनीतिक ट्रैक

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे हमले तेज हुए, राष्ट्रपति वोलोडिमिर ज़ेलेंस्की ने कहा कि यूक्रेन ने वाशिंगटन को युद्ध को समाप्त करने के उद्देश्य से प्रस्तावों का एक नया सेट भेजा है।

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: ज़ेलेंस्की की सरकार ने प्रस्तावों को निरंतर सैन्य दबाव के साथ कूटनीतिक गतिशीलता को जीवित रखने के प्रयास के रूप में तैयार किया है, एक दोहरी-ट्रैक दृष्टिकोण जिसे कीव ने संघर्ष के दौरान विभिन्न बिंदुओं परpursued किया है।

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: चर्चाओं से परिचित अधिकारियों के अनुसार, अमेरिकी वार्ताकारों से आने वाले दिनों में कीव और मास्को दोनों की यात्रा करने की उम्मीद है, जो दोनों पक्षों की स्थितियों के बीच की खाई को कम करने के लिए एक नए धक्का के हिस्से के रूप में है।

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: यूक्रेन के नवीनतम प्रस्तावों का विवरण सार्वजनिक नहीं किया गया है, और यह स्पष्ट नहीं है कि वे क्षेत्रीय लाइनों, सुरक्षा गारंटी और किसी भी युद्धविराम के लिए समय सीमा जैसे मुद्दों पर वाशिंगटन या मास्को द्वारा पहले उठाए गए पदों के साथ कितनी बारीकी से संरेखित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या आता है

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का ध्यान है कि इस युद्ध में तीव्र हमले और सक्रिय बातचीत परस्पर अनन्य नहीं हैं; दोनों पक्षों ने बार-बार युद्ध के मैदान में लाभ की तलाश की है, तब भी जब कूटनीतिक चैनल खुले रहते हैं।

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: आने वाले दिन - अमेरिकी वार्ताकारों के साथ दो राजधानियों के बीच शटल करने के लिए कथित तौर पर सेट - एक स्पष्ट संकेत दे सकते हैं कि क्या वार्ता का वर्तमान दौर एक वास्तविक उद्घाटन का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है या एक ऐसे संघर्ष में एक और अंतराल जो त्वरित संकल्प को परिभाषित करता है।

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, मोर्चे के दोनों तरफ के निवासियों को बढ़ती लंबी दूरी के अभियान के तत्काल परिणामों का सामना करना जारी है, तब भी जब कीव, मास्को और वाशिंगटन में अधिकारी वार्ता की मेज पर अगले चरणों का वजन करते हैं।

segments.src: *This article reflects publicly reported statements from Ukrainian and Russian officials as of this week; details of ongoing military operations and diplomatic talks may evolve rapidly.*
segments.tr: *यह लेख इस सप्ताह के रूप में यूक्रेनी और रूसी अधिकारियों से सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट किए गए बयानों को दर्शाता है; चल रहे सैन्य अभियानों और कूटनीतिक वार्ताओं का विवरण तेजी से विकसित हो सकता है।*

es.title: Cerca de 800 drones en dos días: Los mayores ataques de Ucrania contra Moscú coinciden con un nuevo impulso de paz

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## Una marcada escalada en los ataques de largo alcance

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: Ucrania ha llevado a cabo lo que los funcionarios describen como una de las mayores operaciones de drones de la guerra contra la región de Moscú esta semana, enviando oleadas de aeronaves no tripuladas hacia la capital rusa apenas dos días después de un bombardeo igualmente masivo.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: En conjunto, se informa que las dos salvas involucraron cerca de 800 drones, lo que marca una escalada significativa en el intercambio de largo alcance que ha definido cada vez más la fase reciente del conflicto.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de defensa aérea rusa dijeron que la mayoría de los drones fueron interceptados o interferidos antes de llegar a zonas pobladas, aunque se informaron interrupciones en algunos de los aeropuertos de Moscú, con restricciones temporales de vuelos que afectaron llegadas y salidas.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: Las autoridades locales en la región informaron sobre la caída de escombros en varios distritos, lo que provocó breves evacuaciones e inspecciones, aunque la escala general de los daños no ha sido verificada de forma independiente.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Kiev no ha reclamado oficialmente la responsabilidad de los ataques específicos, en consonancia con su práctica general respecto a las operaciones de largo alcance en lo profundo del territorio ruso.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios ucranianos han dicho anteriormente que tales ataques tienen como objetivo infraestructura militar-industrial, depósitos de combustible y centros logísticos que apoyan el esfuerzo bélico de Rusia.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## Mortal ataque con misiles en la región de Járkov

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: La escalada de drones se produjo en la misma semana en que un ataque con misiles rusos golpeó un pueblo en la región ucraniana de Járkov, matando al menos a diez personas, según funcionarios regionales.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: Las autoridades ucranianas dijeron que el ataque alcanzó una zona residencial, y las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate continuaron en las horas posteriores.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: El ataque atrajo la condena de los funcionarios ucranianos, quienes lo describieron como parte de un patrón más amplio de ataques que afectan áreas civiles cerca de la línea del frente.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios rusos no han emitido comentarios detallados sobre el ataque específico, y las circunstancias siguen siendo parte del registro más amplio y disputado de ataques de largo alcance que ambas partes han llevado a cabo contra objetivos que caracterizan de manera diferente — Kiev típicamente citando objetivos militares y de infraestructura, Moscú a menudo describiendo su propia campaña como dirigida contra activos militares y energéticos ucranianos.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## Una vía diplomática paralela

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: Incluso cuando los ataques se intensificaban, el presidente Volodímir Zelenski dijo que Ucrania ha enviado a Washington un nuevo conjunto de propuestas destinadas a poner fin a la guerra.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: El gobierno de Zelenski ha enmarcado las propuestas como un esfuerzo para mantener vivo el impulso diplomático junto con la continua presión militar, un enfoque de doble vía que Kiev ha seguido en varios momentos a lo largo del conflicto.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: Según funcionarios familiarizados con las discusiones, se espera que los negociadores estadounidenses viajen tanto a Kiev como a Moscú en los próximos días como parte de un impulso renovado para reducir la brecha entre las posiciones de ambas partes.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: Los detalles de las últimas propuestas de Ucrania no se han hecho públicos, y sigue sin estar claro qué tan de cerca se alinean con las posiciones previamente planteadas por Washington o Moscú en temas como líneas territoriales, garantías de seguridad y el cronograma para cualquier alto el fuego.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que los ataques intensificados y las negociaciones activas no son mutuamente excluyentes en esta guerra; ambas partes han buscado repetidamente influencia en el campo de batalla incluso mientras los canales diplomáticos permanecen abiertos.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: Los próximos días —con negociadores estadounidenses supuestamente listos para trasladarse entre las dos capitales— podrían ofrecer una señal más clara de si la ronda actual de conversaciones representa una apertura genuina o otro interludio en un conflicto que ha desafiado una resolución rápida.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: Por ahora, los residentes a ambos lados del frente continúan enfrentando las consecuencias inmediatas de la escalada de la campaña de largo alcance, incluso mientras los funcionarios en Kiev, Moscú y Washington sopesan los próximos pasos en la mesa de negociaciones.

segments.src: *This article reflects publicly reported statements from Ukrainian and Russian officials as of this week; details of ongoing military operations and diplomatic talks may evolve rapidly.*
segments.tr: *Este artículo refleja declaraciones informadas públicamente de funcionarios ucranianos y rusos a partir de esta semana; los detalles de las operaciones militares en curso y las conversaciones diplomáticas pueden evolucionar rápidamente.*

ar.title: ما يقرب من 800 طائرة بدون طيار في يومين: أكبر ضربات أوكرانية على موسكو حتى الآن تتزامن مع مساعٍ جديدة للسلام

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## تصعيد حاد في الضربات بعيدة المدى

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: نفذت أوكرانيا ما وصفه المسؤولون بأنه واحدة من أكبر عمليات الطائرات بدون طيار في الحرب ضد منطقة موسكو هذا الأسبوع، حيث أرسلت موجات من الطائرات غير المأهولة نحو العاصمة الروسية بعد يومين فقط من قصف مكثف مماثل.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: وبشكل مجتمع، يُقال إن الهجومين تضمان ما يقرب من 800 طائرة بدون طيار، مما يمثل تصعيداً كبيراً في التبادل بعيد المدى الذي حدد بشكل متزايد المرحلة الأخيرة من الصراع.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: قال مسؤولو الدفاع الجوي الروسي إن غالبية الطائرات بدون طيار تم اعتراضها أو التشويش عليها قبل وصولها إلى المناطق المأهولة بالسكان، على الرغم من الإبلاغ عن اضطرابات في بعض مطارات موسكو، مع فرض قيود مؤقتة على الرحلات الجوية أثرت على عمليات الوصول والمغادرة.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: أبلغت السلطات المحلية في المنطقة عن سقوط حطام في عدة مقاطعات، مما أدى إلى عمليات إجلاء وتفتيش لفترة وجيزة، على الرغم من أن الحجم الإجمالي للأضرار لم يتم التحقق منه بشكل مستقل.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: لم تعلن كييف رسمياً مسؤوليتها عن الضربات المحددة، تماشياً مع ممارستها العامة فيما يتعلق بالعمليات بعيدة المدى في عمق الأراضي الروسية.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: سبق أن قال مسؤولون أوكرانيون إن مثل هذه الضربات تستهدف البنية التحتية العسكرية والصناعية، ومستودعات الوقود، ومراكز الخدمات اللوجستية التي تدعم المجهود الحربي الروسي.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## ضربة صاروخية دامية على منطقة خاركيف

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: جاء تصعيد الطائرات بدون طيار في نفس الأسبوع الذي أصابت فيه ضربة صاروخية روسية قرية في منطقة خاركيف بأوكرانيا، مما أسفر عن مقتل عشرة أشخاص على الأقل، وفقاً لمسؤولين إقليميين.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: قالت السلطات الأوكرانية إن الضربة أصابت منطقة سكنية، واستمرت عمليات البحث والإنقاذ في الساعات التي تلت ذلك.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: أثار الهجوم إدانة من المسؤولين الأوكرانيين، الذين وصفوه بأنه جزء من نمط أوسع من الضربات التي تؤثر على المناطق المدنية بالقرب من خط المواجهة.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: لم يصدر المسؤولون الروس تعليقاً مفصلاً على الضربة المحددة، ولا تزال الظروف جزءاً من السجل الأوسع والمتنازع عليه للهجمات بعيدة المدى التي نفذها كلا الجانبين ضد أهداف يصفونها بشكل مختلف - حيث تستشهد كييف عادةً بأهداف عسكرية وبنية تحتية، بينما تصف موسكو حملتها غالباً بأنها تستهدف الأصول العسكرية والطاقة الأوكرانية.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## مسار دبلوماسي موازٍ

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: حتى مع تكثيف الضربات، قال الرئيس فولوديمير زيلينسكي إن أوكرانيا أرسلت إلى واشنطن مجموعة جديدة من المقترحات تهدف إلى إنهاء الحرب.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: صاغت حكومة زيلينسكي المقترحات كجهد للحفاظ على الزخم الدبلوماسي حياً إلى جانب الضغط العسكري المستمر، وهو نهج مزدوج المسار اتبعته كييف في نقاط مختلفة طوال فترة الصراع.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: وفقاً لمسؤولين مطلعين على المناقشات، من المتوقع أن يسافر المفاوضون الأمريكيون إلى كل من كييف وموسكو في الأيام المقبلة كجزء من مسعى متجدد لتقليص الفجوة بين مواقف الجانبين.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: لم يتم الإعلان عن تفاصيل أحدث مقترحات أوكرانيا، ولا يزال من غير الواضح مدى توافقها مع المواقف التي طرحتها واشنطن أو موسكو سابقاً بشأن قضايا مثل الخطوط الإقليمية، والضمانات الأمنية، والجدول الزمني لأي وقف لإطلاق النار.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: يشير المحللون إلى أن الضربات المكثفة والمفاوضات النشطة ليست متنافية في هذه الحرب؛ فقد سعى كلا الجانبين مراراً وتكراراً للحصول على نفوذ في ساحة المعركة حتى بينما تظل القنوات الدبلوماسية مفتوحة.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: الأيام المقبلة - مع استعداد المفاوضين الأمريكيين للتنقل بين العاصمتين - قد تقدم إشارة أوضح حول ما إذا كانت الجولة الحالية من المحادثات تمثل انفراجة حقيقية أو مجرد فاصل آخر في صراع استعصى على الحل السريع.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يواصل السكان على جانبي الجبهة مواجهة العواقب المباشرة للحملة بعيدة المدى المتصاعدة، حتى مع قيام المسؤولين في كييف وموسكو وواشنطن بوزن الخطوات التالية على طاولة المفاوضات.

fr.title: Près de 800 drones en deux jours : les plus grandes frappes ukrainiennes sur Moscou coïncident avec une nouvelle initiative de paix

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## Une escalade marquée des frappes à longue portée

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: L'Ukraine a mené ce que les responsables décrivent comme l'une des plus grandes opérations de drones de la guerre contre la région de Moscou cette semaine, envoyant des vagues d'appareils sans pilote vers la capitale russe à peine deux jours après un barrage tout aussi massif.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: Au total, les deux salves auraient impliqué près de 800 drones, marquant une escalade significative dans l'échange à longue portée qui a de plus en plus caractérisé la phase récente du conflit.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: Les responsables de la défense aérienne russe ont déclaré que la majorité des drones avaient été interceptés ou brouillés avant d'atteindre les zones peuplées, bien que des perturbations aient été signalées dans certains aéroports de Moscou, avec des restrictions de vol temporaires affectant les arrivées et les départs.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: Les autorités locales de la région ont signalé des chutes de débris dans plusieurs districts, entraînant de brèves évacuations et des inspections, bien que l'ampleur globale des dégâts n'ait pas été vérifiée de manière indépendante.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Kyiv n'a pas officiellement revendiqué la responsabilité de ces frappes spécifiques, conformément à sa pratique générale concernant les opérations à longue portée au plus profond du territoire russe.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: Des responsables ukrainiens ont précédemment déclaré que ces frappes visaient des infrastructures militaro-industrielles, des dépôts de carburant et des plaques tournantes logistiques qui soutiennent l'effort de guerre de la Russie.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## Frappe de missile meurtrière dans la région de Kharkiv

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: L'escalade des drones est intervenue la même semaine qu'une frappe de missile russe a touché un village dans la région ukrainienne de Kharkiv, tuant au moins dix personnes, selon des responsables régionaux.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: Les autorités ukrainiennes ont déclaré que la frappe avait touché une zone résidentielle et les opérations de recherche et de sauvetage se sont poursuivies dans les heures qui ont suivi.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: L'attaque a suscité la condamnation de responsables ukrainiens, qui l'ont décrite comme faisant partie d'un schéma plus large de frappes touchant des zones civiles près de la ligne de front.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: Les responsables russes n'ont pas fait de commentaires détaillés sur cette frappe spécifique, et les circonstances restent inscrites dans le dossier plus large et contesté des attaques à longue portée que les deux camps ont menées contre des cibles qu'ils qualifient différemment — Kyiv citant généralement des objectifs militaires et d'infrastructure, Moscou décrivant souvent sa propre campagne comme ciblant des actifs militaires et énergétiques ukrainiens.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## Une voie diplomatique parallèle

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: Alors même que les frappes s'intensifiaient, le président Volodymyr Zelenskyy a déclaré que l'Ukraine avait transmis à Washington une nouvelle série de propositions visant à mettre fin à la guerre.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement de Zelenskyy a présenté ces propositions comme un effort pour maintenir l'élan diplomatique vivant parallèlement à une pression militaire continue, une approche à double volet que Kyiv a poursuivie à divers moments tout au long du conflit.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: Selon des responsables familiers avec les discussions, les négociateurs américains devraient se rendre à la fois à Kyiv et à Moscou dans les jours à venir dans le cadre d'une nouvelle initiative visant à réduire l'écart entre les positions des deux parties.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: Les détails des dernières propositions de l'Ukraine n'ont pas été rendus publics, et il reste flou de savoir dans quelle mesure elles s'alignent sur les positions précédemment avancées par Washington ou Moscou sur des questions telles que les lignes territoriales, les garanties de sécurité et le calendrier d'un éventuel cessez-le-feu.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Que va-t-il se passer ensuite

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: Les analystes soulignent que l'intensification des frappes et des négociations actives ne s'excluent pas mutuellement dans cette guerre ; les deux camps ont à plusieurs reprises cherché un levier sur le champ de bataille tout en maintenant les canaux diplomatiques ouverts.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: Les jours à venir — avec des négociateurs américains qui devraient faire la navette entre les deux capitales — pourraient offrir un signal plus clair quant à savoir si le cycle actuel de pourparlers représente une véritable ouverture ou un autre intermède dans un conflit qui a résisté à une résolution rapide.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les résidents des deux côtés du front continuent de faire face aux conséquences immédiates de l'escalade de la campagne à longue portée, alors même que les responsables à Kyiv, Moscou et Washington pèsent les prochaines étapes à la table des négociations.

segments.tr: *Cet article reflète les déclarations rapportées publiquement par des responsables ukrainiens et russes à compter de cette semaine ; les détails des opérations militaires en cours et des pourparlers diplomatiques peuvent évoluer rapidement.*

pt.title: Quase 800 drones em dois dias: os maiores ataques da Ucrânia a Moscou coincidem com novo impulso pela paz

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## Uma escalada acentuada nos ataques de longo alcance

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: A Ucrânia realizou o que as autoridades descrevem como uma das maiores operações de drones da guerra contra a região de Moscou esta semana, enviando ondas de aeronaves não tripuladas em direção à capital russa apenas dois dias após uma barragem igualmente massiva.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: Combinadas, as duas salvas teriam envolvido cerca de 800 drones, marcando uma escalada significativa na troca de ataques de longo alcance que tem definido cada vez mais a fase recente do conflito.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: Autoridades de defesa aérea russas disseram que a maioria dos drones foi interceptada ou bloqueada antes de atingir áreas povoadas, embora interrupções tenham sido relatadas em alguns dos aeroportos de Moscou, com restrições temporárias de voo afetando chegadas e partidas.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: Autoridades locais na região relataram queda de destroços em vários distritos, provocando evacuações e inspeções breves, embora a escala geral dos danos não tenha sido verificada de forma independente.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Kiev não assumiu oficialmente a responsabilidade pelos ataques específicos, mantendo sua prática geral em relação a operações de longo alcance no interior do território russo.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: Autoridades ucranianas disseram anteriormente que tais ataques visam infraestrutura militar-industrial, depósitos de combustível e centros logísticos que apoiam o esforço de guerra da Rússia.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## Ataque mortal com mísseis na região de Kharkiv

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: A escalada dos drones ocorreu na mesma semana em que um ataque com mísseis russos atingiu uma vila na região de Kharkiv, na Ucrânia, matando pelo menos dez pessoas, segundo autoridades regionais.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: Autoridades ucranianas disseram que o ataque atingiu uma área residencial, e as operações de busca e resgate continuaram nas horas seguintes.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: O ataque gerou condenação de autoridades ucranianas, que o descreveram como parte de um padrão mais amplo de ataques que afetam áreas civis perto da linha de frente.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: Autoridades russas não emitiram comentários detalhados sobre o ataque específico, e as circunstâncias permanecem parte do registro mais amplo e contestado de ataques de longo alcance que ambos os lados realizaram contra alvos que caracterizam de forma diferente — Kiev geralmente citando objetivos militares e de infraestrutura, Moscou frequentemente descrevendo sua própria campanha como visando ativos militares e energéticos ucranianos.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## Uma via diplomática paralela

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: Mesmo com a intensificação dos ataques, o presidente Volodymyr Zelenskyy disse que a Ucrânia enviou a Washington um novo conjunto de propostas destinadas a acabar com a guerra.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: O governo de Zelenskyy enquadrou as propostas como um esforço para manter o impulso diplomático vivo ao lado da pressão militar contínua, uma abordagem de via dupla que Kiev buscou em vários momentos ao longo do conflito.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: De acordo com autoridades familiarizadas com as discussões, espera-se que negociadores americanos viajem tanto para Kiev quanto para Moscou nos próximos dias como parte de um novo impulso para diminuir a lacuna entre as posições dos dois lados.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: Os detalhes das últimas propostas da Ucrânia não foram tornados públicos, e permanece incerto o quão estreitamente elas se alinham com as posições anteriormente ventiladas por Washington ou Moscou em questões como linhas territoriais, garantias de segurança e o cronograma para qualquer cessar-fogo.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O que vem a seguir

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: Analistas observam que ataques intensificados e negociações ativas não são mutuamente exclusivos nesta guerra; ambos os lados buscaram repetidamente alavancagem no campo de batalha mesmo enquanto os canais diplomáticos permanecem abertos.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: Os próximos dias — com negociadores dos EUA supostamente prontos para viajar entre as duas capitais — podem oferecer um sinal mais claro de se a rodada atual de conversas representa uma abertura genuína ou outro interlúdio em um conflito que desafiou uma resolução rápida.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, os residentes em ambos os lados da frente continuam a enfrentar as consequências imediatas da escalada da campanha de longo alcance, mesmo enquanto autoridades em Kiev, Moscou e Washington avaliam os próximos passos na mesa de negociações.

segments.tr: *Este artigo reflete declarações relatadas publicamente de autoridades ucranianas e russas até esta semana; detalhes de operações militares em curso e conversas diplomáticas podem evoluir rapidamente.*

in.title: Hampir 800 Drone dalam Dua Hari: Serangan Terbesar Ukraina ke Moskow Bertepatan dengan Upaya Perdamaian Baru

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## Eskalasi Tajam dalam Serangan Jarak Jauh

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: Ukraina telah melakukan apa yang digambarkan oleh para pejabat sebagai salah satu operasi drone terbesar dalam perang melawan wilayah Moskow minggu ini, mengirimkan gelombang pesawat nirawak menuju ibu kota Rusia hanya dua hari setelah rentetan serangan masif serupa.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: Secara gabungan, kedua serangan tersebut dilaporkan melibatkan hampir 800 drone, menandai eskalasi signifikan dalam pertukaran serangan jarak jauh yang semakin mendefinisikan fase konflik baru-baru ini.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: Pejabat pertahanan udara Rusia mengatakan sebagian besar drone dicegat atau diganggu sebelum mencapai daerah berpenduduk, meskipun gangguan dilaporkan terjadi di beberapa bandara Moskow, dengan pembatasan penerbangan sementara yang memengaruhi kedatangan dan keberangkatan.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: Otoritas lokal di wilayah tersebut melaporkan adanya puing-puing yang jatuh di beberapa distrik, yang memicu evakuasi dan inspeksi singkat, meskipun skala kerusakan secara keseluruhan belum diverifikasi secara independen.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Kyiv belum secara resmi mengklaim tanggung jawab atas serangan spesifik tersebut, sesuai dengan praktik umumnya terkait operasi jarak jauh jauh di dalam wilayah Rusia.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: Pejabat Ukraina sebelumnya mengatakan serangan semacam itu menargetkan infrastruktur militer-industri, depot bahan bakar, dan pusat logistik yang mendukung upaya perang Rusia.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## Serangan Rudal Mematikan di Wilayah Kharkiv

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: Eskalasi drone terjadi pada minggu yang sama ketika serangan rudal Rusia menghantam sebuah desa di wilayah Kharkiv, Ukraina, menewaskan sedikitnya sepuluh orang, menurut pejabat regional.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: Otoritas Ukraina mengatakan serangan itu menghantam area perumahan, dan operasi pencarian dan penyelamatan berlanjut beberapa jam setelahnya.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: Serangan tersebut menuai kecaman dari pejabat Ukraina, yang menggambarkannya sebagai bagian dari pola serangan yang lebih luas yang memengaruhi area sipil di dekat garis depan.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: Pejabat Rusia belum mengeluarkan komentar rinci mengenai serangan spesifik tersebut, dan situasinya tetap menjadi bagian dari catatan serangan jarak jauh yang lebih luas dan disengketakan yang dilakukan oleh kedua belah pihak terhadap target yang mereka karakterisasi secara berbeda — Kyiv biasanya mengutip tujuan militer dan infrastruktur, Moskow sering menggambarkan kampanyenya sendiri sebagai menargetkan aset militer dan energi Ukraina.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## Jalur Diplomatik Paralel

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: Bahkan saat serangan meningkat, Presiden Volodymyr Zelenskyy mengatakan Ukraina telah mengirimkan serangkaian proposal baru ke Washington yang bertujuan untuk mengakhiri perang.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: Pemerintahan Zelenskyy telah membingkai proposal tersebut sebagai upaya untuk menjaga momentum diplomatik tetap hidup di samping tekanan militer yang berkelanjutan, pendekatan jalur ganda yang telah dikejar Kyiv di berbagai titik sepanjang konflik.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: Menurut pejabat yang mengetahui diskusi tersebut, negosiator Amerika diperkirakan akan melakukan perjalanan ke Kyiv dan Moskow dalam beberapa hari mendatang sebagai bagian dari dorongan baru untuk mempersempit kesenjangan antara posisi kedua belah pihak.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: Rincian proposal terbaru Ukraina belum dipublikasikan, dan masih belum jelas seberapa dekat proposal tersebut selaras dengan posisi yang sebelumnya dilontarkan oleh Washington atau Moskow mengenai masalah seperti garis teritorial, jaminan keamanan, dan garis waktu untuk gencatan senjata apa pun.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa serangan yang meningkat dan negosiasi aktif tidak saling eksklusif dalam perang ini; kedua belah pihak telah berulang kali mencari pengaruh di medan perang bahkan saat saluran diplomatik tetap terbuka.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: Hari-hari mendatang — dengan negosiator AS yang dilaporkan akan bolak-balik antara kedua ibu kota — dapat menawarkan sinyal yang lebih jelas tentang apakah putaran pembicaraan saat ini mewakili pembukaan yang tulus atau jeda lain dalam konflik yang telah menentang penyelesaian cepat.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, penduduk di kedua sisi garis depan terus menghadapi konsekuensi langsung dari kampanye jarak jauh yang meningkat, bahkan saat para pejabat di Kyiv, Moskow, dan Washington mempertimbangkan langkah selanjutnya di meja perundingan.

ja.title: 2日間で800機近くのドローン：ウクライナによるモスクワへの過去最大規模の攻撃と新たな和平交渉の動き

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## 長距離攻撃の急激なエスカレーション

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: ウクライナは今週、モスクワ地域に対して開戦以来最大規模のドローン作戦の一つを実行したと当局が説明しており、同様の大規模な一斉攻撃からわずか2日後に、ロシアの首都に向けて無人航空機の波を送り込んだ。

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: これら2回の攻撃を合わせると、800機近いドローンが関与したと報じられており、紛争の最近の局面を特徴づける長距離攻撃の応酬において、重大なエスカレーションを示している。

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: ロシアの防空当局は、ドローンの大半は人口密集地に到達する前に迎撃または妨害されたと述べたが、モスクワの一部の空港では混乱が報告され、一時的な飛行制限により到着便や出発便に影響が出た。

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: 同地域の地元当局は、いくつかの地区で破片が落下したと報告し、短時間の避難や点検が行われたが、被害の全体的な規模は独自に検証されていない。

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: キエフは、ロシア領土深部への長距離作戦に関する一般的な慣行に従い、今回の特定の攻撃について公式に責任を認めていない。

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: ウクライナ当局は以前、こうした攻撃はロシアの戦争努力を支える軍事産業インフラ、燃料貯蔵所、物流拠点を標的にしていると述べている。

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## ハルキウ地域への致命的なミサイル攻撃

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: ドローンによるエスカレーションと同じ週に、ロシアのミサイル攻撃がウクライナのハルキウ地域の村を襲い、地域当局によると少なくとも10人が死亡した。

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: ウクライナ当局は、攻撃は住宅地を直撃したと述べ、その後数時間にわたって捜索救助活動が続けられた。

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: この攻撃はウクライナ当局から非難を浴び、前線近くの民間地域に影響を与える広範な攻撃パターンの一部であると説明された。

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: ロシア当局はこの特定の攻撃について詳細なコメントを出しておらず、その状況は、双方が異なる性格付けをする標的（キエフは通常、軍事およびインフラの目標を挙げ、モスクワは自国の作戦をウクライナの軍事およびエネルギー資産を標的としていると説明することが多い）に対して行われる長距離攻撃の、より広範で論争の的となっている記録の一部として残っている。

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## 並行する外交トラック

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: 攻撃が激化する中でも、ウォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領は、ウクライナが戦争終結を目指す新たな提案をワシントンに送ったと述べた。

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: ゼレンスキー政権は、この提案を、継続的な軍事的圧力と並行して外交的勢いを維持するための取り組みとして位置づけており、これはキエフが紛争を通じて様々な時点で追求してきた二重トラックのアプローチである。

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: 協議に詳しい当局者によると、アメリカの交渉担当者は、双方の立場間の溝を埋めるための新たな取り組みの一環として、今後数日以内にキエフとモスクワの両方を訪問する予定である。

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: ウクライナの最新の提案の詳細は公表されておらず、領土境界線、安全保障、停戦のタイムラインといった問題について、ワシントンやモスクワが以前に提示した立場とどの程度一致しているかは依然として不明である。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展望

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: アナリストは、この戦争において、攻撃の激化と積極的な交渉は相互に排他的なものではないと指摘している。双方は、外交チャンネルが開かれている間も、繰り返し戦場での優位性を求めてきた。

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: 米国の交渉担当者が両首都間を往復する予定である今後数日間は、現在の交渉ラウンドが真の打開策となるのか、それとも迅速な解決を拒んできた紛争における単なる一幕に過ぎないのかについて、より明確なシグナルが得られる可能性がある。

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: 今のところ、前線の両側に住む住民は、キエフ、モスクワ、ワシントンの当局者が交渉のテーブルで次のステップを検討している間も、エスカレートする長距離キャンペーンの直接的な結果に直面し続けている。

segments.tr: *この記事は、今週時点でのウクライナおよびロシア当局からの公に報告された声明を反映したものであり、進行中の軍事作戦や外交交渉の詳細は急速に変化する可能性がある。*

de.title: Fast 800 Drohnen in zwei Tagen: Bisher Ukrainas größte Angriffe auf Moskau fallen mit neuer Friedensinitiative zusammen

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation in Long-Range Strikes
segments.tr: ## Eine scharfe Eskalation bei Langstreckenangriffen

segments.src: Ukraine has carried out what officials describe as one of the largest drone operations of the war against the Moscow region this week, sending waves of unmanned aircraft toward the Russian capital just two days after a similarly massive barrage.
segments.tr: Die Ukraine hat diese Woche nach Angaben von Beamten eine der größten Drohnenoperationen des Krieges gegen die Region Moskau durchgeführt und wellenartig unbemannte Flugzeuge in Richtung der russischen Hauptstadt geschickt, nur zwei Tage nach einem ähnlich massiven Sperrfeuer.

segments.src: Combined, the two salvos are reported to have involved close to 800 drones, marking a significant escalation in the long-range exchange that has increasingly defined the conflict's recent phase.
segments.tr: Zusammengenommen sollen an den beiden Salven fast 800 Drohnen beteiligt gewesen sein, was eine signifikante Eskalation des Langstreckenaustauschs darstellt, der die jüngste Phase des Konflikts zunehmend prägt.

segments.src: Russian air defense officials said the majority of the drones were intercepted or jammed before reaching populated areas, though disruptions were reported at some of Moscow's airports, with temporary flight restrictions affecting arrivals and departures.
segments.tr: Russische Luftverteidigungsbeamte gaben an, dass die Mehrheit der Drohnen abgefangen oder gestört wurde, bevor sie bevölkerte Gebiete erreichten, obwohl Störungen an einigen Flughäfen Moskaus gemeldet wurden, wobei temporäre Flugbeschränkungen An- und Abflüge betrafen.

segments.src: Local authorities in the region reported falling debris in several districts, prompting brief evacuations and inspections, though the overall scale of damage has not been independently verified.
segments.tr: Lokale Behörden in der Region meldeten herabfallende Trümmerteile in mehreren Bezirken, was zu kurzen Evakuierungen und Inspektionen führte, obwohl das Gesamtausmaß der Schäden nicht unabhängig überprüft wurde.

segments.src: Kyiv has not officially claimed responsibility for the specific strikes, in keeping with its general practice regarding long-range operations deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Kiew hat die Verantwortung für die spezifischen Angriffe nicht offiziell übernommen, was seiner allgemeinen Praxis in Bezug auf Langstreckenoperationen tief im russischen Territorium entspricht.

segments.src: Ukrainian officials have previously said such strikes target military-industrial infrastructure, fuel depots, and logistics hubs that support Russia's war effort.
segments.tr: Ukrainische Beamte haben zuvor erklärt, dass solche Angriffe auf militärisch-industrielle Infrastruktur, Treibstofflager und Logistikzentren abzielen, die die Kriegsanstrengungen Russlands unterstützen.

segments.src: ## Deadly Missile Strike on Kharkiv Region
segments.tr: ## Tödlicher Raketenangriff auf die Region Charkiw

segments.src: The drone escalation came in the same week that a Russian missile strike hit a village in Ukraine's Kharkiv region, killing at least ten people, according to regional officials.
segments.tr: Die Drohneneskalation erfolgte in derselben Woche, in der ein russischer Raketenangriff ein Dorf in der ukrainischen Region Charkiw traf und nach Angaben regionaler Beamter mindestens zehn Menschen tötete.

segments.src: Ukrainian authorities said the strike hit a residential area, and search-and-rescue operations continued in the hours afterward.
segments.tr: Ukrainische Behörden teilten mit, dass der Angriff ein Wohngebiet getroffen habe, und Such- und Rettungsmaßnahmen in den Stunden danach fortgesetzt wurden.

segments.src: The attack drew condemnation from Ukrainian officials, who described it as part of a broader pattern of strikes affecting civilian areas near the front line.
segments.tr: Der Angriff stieß bei ukrainischen Beamten auf Verurteilung, die ihn als Teil eines breiteren Musters von Angriffen auf zivile Gebiete in der Nähe der Frontlinie bezeichneten.

segments.src: Russian officials have not issued detailed comment on the specific strike, and the circumstances remain part of the broader, contested record of long-range attacks that both sides have carried out against targets they characterize differently — Kyiv typically citing military and infrastructure objectives, Moscow often describing its own campaign as targeting Ukrainian military and energy assets.
segments.tr: Russische Beamte haben keine detaillierten Kommentare zu dem spezifischen Angriff abgegeben, und die Umstände bleiben Teil der breiteren, umstrittenen Bilanz von Langstreckenangriffen, die beide Seiten gegen Ziele durchgeführt haben, die sie unterschiedlich charakterisieren – Kiew beruft sich typischerweise auf militärische und infrastrukturelle Ziele, während Moskau seine eigene Kampagne oft als Angriff auf ukrainische Militär- und Energieanlagen beschreibt.

segments.src: ## A Parallel Diplomatic Track
segments.tr: ## Eine parallele diplomatische Spur

segments.src: Even as the strikes intensified, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has sent Washington a fresh set of proposals aimed at ending the war.
segments.tr: Sogar während sich die Angriffe verstärkten, sagte Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj, die Ukraine habe Washington eine neue Reihe von Vorschlägen zur Beendigung des Krieges übermittelt.

segments.src: Zelenskyy's government has framed the proposals as an effort to keep diplomatic momentum alive alongside continued military pressure, a dual-track approach Kyiv has pursued at various points throughout the conflict.
segments.tr: Selenskyjs Regierung hat die Vorschläge als Bemühung dargestellt, die diplomatische Dynamik neben dem anhaltenden militärischen Druck am Leben zu erhalten, ein zweigleisiger Ansatz, den Kiew während des gesamten Konflikts zu verschiedenen Zeitpunkten verfolgt hat.

segments.src: According to officials familiar with the discussions, American negotiators are expected to travel to both Kyiv and Moscow in the coming days as part of a renewed push to narrow the gap between the two sides' positions.
segments.tr: Berichten von mit den Gesprächen vertrauten Beamten zufolge werden amerikanische Unterhändler in den kommenden Tagen voraussichtlich sowohl nach Kiew als auch nach Moskau reisen, als Teil eines erneuten Vorstoßes, die Kluft zwischen den Positionen der beiden Seiten zu verringern.

segments.src: Details of Ukraine's latest proposals have not been made public, and it remains unclear how closely they align with positions previously floated by Washington or Moscow on issues such as territorial lines, security guarantees, and the timeline for any ceasefire.
segments.tr: Einzelheiten zu den neuesten Vorschlägen der Ukraine wurden nicht öffentlich gemacht, und es bleibt unklar, wie genau sie mit Positionen übereinstimmen, die zuvor von Washington oder Moskau in Fragen wie territorialen Linien, Sicherheitsgarantien und dem Zeitplan für einen Waffenstillstand ins Spiel gebracht wurden.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes kommt

segments.src: Analysts note that intensified strikes and active negotiations are not mutually exclusive in this war; both sides have repeatedly sought battlefield leverage even while diplomatic channels remain open.
segments.tr: Analysten weisen darauf hin, dass intensivierte Angriffe und aktive Verhandlungen in diesem Krieg sich nicht gegenseitig ausschließen; beide Seiten haben wiederholt nach Verhandlungsmasse auf dem Schlachtfeld gesucht, selbst während diplomatische Kanäle offen bleiben.

segments.src: The coming days — with US negotiators reportedly set to shuttle between the two capitals — could offer a clearer signal of whether the current round of talks represents a genuine opening or another interlude in a conflict that has defied quick resolution.
segments.tr: Die kommenden Tage – in denen US-Unterhändler Berichten zufolge zwischen den beiden Hauptstädten pendeln werden – könnten ein klareres Signal dafür liefern, ob die aktuelle Gesprächsrunde eine echte Öffnung oder nur ein weiteres Intermezzo in einem Konflikt darstellt, der sich einer schnellen Lösung entzogen hat.

segments.src: For now, residents on both sides of the front continue to face the immediate consequences of the escalating long-range campaign, even as officials in Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington weigh next steps at the negotiating table.
segments.tr: Für den Moment sind die Bewohner auf beiden Seiten der Front weiterhin mit den unmittelbaren Folgen der eskalierenden Langstreckenkampagne konfrontiert, selbst während Beamte in Kiew, Moskau und Washington die nächsten Schritte am Verhandlungstisch abwägen.
